snippet.title: Game About Botting in an MMORPG - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Game About Botting in an MMORPG Demo ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4825990/Game_About_Botting_in_an_MMORPG_Demo/

"Why grind when you can cheat? Start as a novice grinder and work your way towards total automation. Unlock Bot Modules, configure combat behavior, optimize farming routes and build the ultimate grinding machine in this incremental MMORPG simulator."
